en.headline: Influenza remains high; eight in ten cases are H1, director says
en.dek: Laboratory positive rate reached 13 per cent last week and hospital admission rates stay above baseline, according to the Director of Health.
body: Seasonal influenza activity remains elevated, Director of Health Dr Ronald Lam said on Saturday, with the laboratory positive rate at 13 per cent last week, higher than the same period last year.

About 80 per cent of cases are influenza A(H1), with the remainder mostly A(H3) and a small number of B. Hospital admission rates stood at 0.83 per 10,000 population, above the baseline. Nineteen severe paediatric cases have been recorded this season, including one death.

The 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programmes begin on 17 September. More than 99 per cent of schools are taking part in the outreach scheme, and the Department of Health aims to complete vaccination at 80 schools this month. Dr Lam urged parents and high-risk groups to get vaccinated promptly.

zh.headline: 流感仍處高位 八成屬甲型H1 林文健籲盡快接種
zh.dek: 上周化驗室陽性比率達13%，入院率高於基線，兒童嚴重個案累計19宗。
body: 衞生署署長林文健周六表示，本港流感活躍度自6月起呈波浪式上升，上周化驗室呼吸道樣本陽性比率達13%，高於去年同期，入院比率每萬人0.83宗，高於基線水平。
目前約八成個案屬甲型H1，約兩成屬甲型H3，少數為乙型。本流感季節累計錄得19宗兒童嚴重個案，其中一人死亡。署方基因分析顯示本地病毒與海外無重大差異。
2026/27年度季節性流感疫苗接種計劃將於9月17日展開，超過99%學校參與外展接種，目標本月內完成80間學校。林文健呼籲市民尤其高風險群組盡快接種疫苗。
